units.source_text: 源氏命夕雾入大学寮研习汉学，必须给他取个字号。

en.t: Genji ordered Yugiri to enter the university bureau to study Chinese learning, so a courtesy name had to be chosen for him.

units.source_text: 这仪式在二条院附近的东院内举行。

en.t: The ceremony was held in the eastern residence near Nijo-in.
The eastern hall of that eastern residence was used as the venue.

units.source_text: 朝中高官贵族以及殿上人等，认为这仪式很稀罕，大家都来参与。

en.t: High officials, nobles, and courtiers at court found the ceremony unusual, and they all came to take part.

units.source_text: 那些儒学博士上殿来，看到这富丽堂皇的场面，反而觉得畏缩了。

en.t: When the Confucian scholars came up into the hall and saw the splendid scene, they became intimidated instead.

units.source_text: 源氏对众人说：“大家不要因为这里是宫邸而有所顾忌。

en.t: Genji said to everyone, Do not hold back just because this is a princely residence.

units.source_text: 应该依照儒学家家中的向例，绝不变通，严格执行！”

en.t: You should follow the customary practice of a Confucian scholar's household, make no changes at all, and carry it out strictly.

units.source_text: 儒学博士们便努力镇静，装作泰然自若。

en.t: The Confucian scholars then tried hard to steady themselves and acted as though perfectly composed.

units.source_text: 有几个人穿着借来的衣服，不称身体，姿态奇特，也不以为耻。

en.t: Several of them wore borrowed clothes that did not fit their bodies, giving them odd postures, yet they felt no shame.

units.source_text: 他们的面貌神气十足，说话声音慢条斯理，规行矩步，鱼贯入座，这光景真乃见所未见，青年贵公子们看了，都忍不住笑出来。

en.t: Their faces were full of self-importance, their voices slow and deliberate, and they observed every rule as they filed into their seats; it was truly a sight never seen before, and the young noblemen who watched could not help laughing.
